title.rendered: It’s high time for Educational Equality!

content.rendered:
India & Nepal are 2 of the few countries in the world where unfortunately caste system is imbibed deep into the roots of everything. Education is no exception! With the recent suicide of a student scholar in Hyderabad due to relevant issues (as claimed by major sources as of now), it has turned out to be a burning issue in the media, although it was always there.

As written by the student who had committed suicide in his heart-wrenching death note, “Our feelings are second-handed. Our love is constructed. Our beliefs are colored. Our originality is valid through artificial art. It has become truly difficult to love without getting hurt. The value of a man was reduced to his immediate identity and nearest possibility. To a vote. To a number. To a thing. Never was a man treated as a mind. As a glorious thing made up of stardust. In every field, in studies, in streets, in politics, and in dying and living.”

Regardless of the actual intentions of the student (which is still under debate), the point that has come up into the limelight currently is true to the core and has to be addressed properly as soon as possible. Not just caste, there have been many factors influencing the way education is offered – like gender, color, etc. While some institutions are seeking a positive change, most are still stuck in the age-old ‘divided’ educational systems.

There are numerous institutions where “division” plays a major factor in the admission of a student into a college. Caste-based grouping in colleges is also not new. So-called-leaders from politics have always played an important role in arousing this caste-based ganging in colleges. While at times some are expelled from participation in major events like college elections, during other times some are left beyond merit-seating in spite of being better at the subject, due to some ‘constitutional-articulations.

This divided education system has been a deciding factor for education in many parts of India & Nepal. This unfortunate scenario has never led to the victory of any part of this ‘division’. All that it resulted in was the diminishing of education. While true talents might get rooted down, unnecessary differences within the students themselves raises due to the involvement of external factors in education.

It’s high time the system sees a fresh change. We, Admizz.com, strongly condemn the involvement of caste or gender or any other biasing factor in education. We believe that education is everyone’s birthright and has to be given with no discrimination. This is the way to lead the country toward a better future.

Do share your opinions on this issue.

title.rendered: Learning a new sport isn’s a kids thing!

content.rendered:
“The whole of life, from the moment you are born to the moment you die, is a process of learning.”

Yes, learning is definitely a continuous process. Age should never become a hindrance to the kid in you to explore the horizons. It’s not too late to try a new sport, whether it’s one that was a childhood dream or something that caught your fancy as an adult. Learning a new sport makes you rediscover yourself and helps you to be physically active and fit. Learning something new can be quite challenging at times, thus people often tend to avoid doing that. Some love to experiment and engage in new stuff, while others avoid manifesting their ideas. Why now u may ask. Here are some of the many benefits in learning a new sport.

It’s fun: Yeah yeah you are definitely aware of this and we know that. But let us ask you something when was the last time you had fun learning something new? A long time ago? Then it’s very likely that you forgot how fun it is to learn new stuff in the first place. It gives you a sense of accomplishment and pride. You will be working out even without your knowledge and you will even enjoy it.

Physical Health: We all hate to exercise, in spite of the fat growing under our skin. Sport is a shortcut to exercise with additional benefits of entertainment and all the below ones! So why get old early when we can stay fit with sports?

It’s good for your brain: There are loads of studies that show that exercise is good for your brain health and improves cognitive function. In fact, exercise can even help ward off some types of age-related cognitive decline such as reduced hand-eye coordination and memory loss. You can stay fit and healthy by learning a new sport and also it’s fun. It’s like a double bonanza isn’t it?

It helps you to meet new people: There are other people that do the thing that you wanna try, so chances are that you have similar tastes in stuff, thus making you potential friends. You can meet like-minded people and it brings a lot of energy to your day.

It may help you discover your own hidden talent: A new sport challenges you both mentally and physically. It will make you push yourself and in the process, you may discover your hidden talent. Many artists, writers, and athletes never knew what they are capable of until they tried something for the first time

Do you still want other reasons?? JUST DO IT!

Explore, learn and never forget to be awesome!

1. Conferred Category ‘A’ status by Ministry of Human Resources Development, Government of India in 2014

2.‘Tier 1’ Accreditation for Undergraduate Engineering programmes by National Board of Accreditation, which is a permanent signatory member of Washington Accord

3. Education Excellence Award for Best Private University by Brands Academy

4. Best University award by Europe Business Assembly

title.rendered: MBA in Rural Management at KIIT University

content.rendered:
The KIIT School of Rural Management (KSRM), Bhubaneswar was established on 20th November 2006 as a constituent of KIIT, Bhubaneswar. It offers 2 years MBA (Rural Management) program with triple benefits namely knowledge, experience, and career: the knowledge through courses in the Rural Management domain, experience through its field segments, and career through a placement program. So far, we have offered exciting careers to 462 students who passed out from KSRM.

In the last 10 years of its existence, KSRM has constantly worked to improve the rigor of its programs to offer a portfolio of triple benefits to students. Having grown vertically in terms of the quality of our program, we are now attempting to expand horizontally to cover all the geographies and streams of graduation within the country. The larger objective is to bring different perspectives and thoughts to Rural Management discipline and holistically develop Rural India to eliminate inequality of all kinds.

Having developed our own knowledge base in the Indian context with the untiring efforts of faculty and students we are sure of bringing new connections between our thoughts and ground reality. Research helps us to substantially revise our field segments and course content which have also been approved by high profile Board of Studies of KSRM with representation from institutes like IRMA, IIT Mumbai, MDI Gurgaon, and a leading NGO.

Therefore, we are ready to intensify our efforts and create connections with highly motivated potential students and increase our student strength by close to a hundred.

The KIIT has been categorized as an “A” Grade university by the Ministry of Human Resource Development, Government of India based on Tandon Committee Recommendations. The MBA (RM) program is approved by AICTE.

Accreditation by NAAC of UGC with an ‘A’ Grade.

Accreditation by NBA of AICTE.

The MBA (RM) Programme is approved by the Association of Indian Universities (AIU) and graduates are eligible to enroll in fellow/doctoral programs in leading Institutes Deemed to be Universities.

To apply for Admission one needs to appear for KIITEE Management, KIITEE / CAT / XAT / CMAT / MAT, and other exam scores for appearing in Group Discussion (GD) and/or Personal Interview (PI) at Bhubaneswar, Kolkata, New Delhi, Bangalore, and Mumbai.

For Foreign students there’s a direct admission facility, to apply to click the link https://bit.ly/2WvpN8q

title.rendered: New age courses that can help you build a great career

content.rendered:
What constitutes a well-rounded education? The answer to this question is an ever-evolving one. In Our country, any education with science, technology, engineering, and math as subjects has been seen as a career-ready degree. But now everyone started to realize the importance of creativity and imagination. The new age courses are more focused on students’ passion. These liberal arts will help an individual to participate in active civic life. Let’s take a look at new-age courses that will help you build a great career without sacrificing your passion.

Animation: A career in animation is relatively new as compared to other traditional careers in the Service or manufacturing sectors. Animation is now widely used in the entertainment industry. It is a combination of art and technology, wherein you can design a film to impress, entertain and educate the viewers. Those with drawing skills and creative thinking can build a great career in the animation industry. The application of this art form is varied and its scope is truly unlimited. There are many animation colleges offering courses on 2D and 3D animations.

Performing arts: Performing arts are no new-age courses and have a rich history. Performing arts range from vocal and instrumental music, dance, and theatre to pantomime, sung verse, and beyond. These arts reflect human creativity and cultural expression. Though these arts are not new and have a history as old as human civilization itself, interesting career opportunities are increasing now. Artists’ impact on society can never be measured.

Golf coaching: With the rising income level of the middle-income groups, growing purchasing power, rising middle-class populace, and greater participation in sports by youth, golf as a sport has developed remarkably in our country in the last couple of years. Golf on a global level is a very popular game but in our country golf industry is at the development stage and it has a scarcity of professional golf trainers. There are programs that offer all individuals who are desirous of becoming teaching professionals the opportunity to attend training programs to learn how to teach the game of golf.

Fashion Designing: Fashion design is the applied art devoted to the designing of clothing and lifestyle accessories. Fashion designing is one of the most lucrative, appealing, glamorous, and exciting career options in today’s world. If you have a penchant for creativity, style, and originality, a career in fashion design is the one tailor-made for you. There are many colleges offering courses in fashion design. The fashion industry in our country is ever growing and there is unlimited scope.

Film making: Well, who doesn’t like films? There are many people who are enthusiastic about filmmaking but are not ready to take risks. A career in the film industry is lucrative and attractive. There is no better way than learning filmmaking techniques and story writing from seasoned film and television professionals. There are many film institutes, that will help you get a hands-on experience in filmmaking, story writing, and acting.

Foreign language courses: Knowledge of one or more foreign languages can be useful in a wide range of careers. For some jobs, such as translating, interpreting, and language teaching, language skills are one of the main requirements. And also with local companies emerging as global players and our market being eyed by multinational companies, it becomes essential that there is no dearth of professionals who can overcome language barriers and facilitate smooth communication for proper business transactions.

As Albert Einstein Rightly said: “Logic will get you from A to B. Imagination will take you everywhere.” We, at admizz.com, can help you find out the perfect institute to do these courses. Here is a small brief about us.

In the present world of huge competition, choosing the right institute is as important as choosing the right course. With too many institutions around, it is natural that one gets confused. It is very diﬃcult to select which is the best institution to study the course of your choice. Selecting the right institution is a one-time decision that will decide how your future will be. In order to help students overcome this uneasy task, we have started Admizz.com.

Admizz with the byword “Admission with Ease” helps to provide all the required information about the institutions and apply to the desired institute for Admission purposes. This is our small step towards digitizing the process of admission in the education system. We believe that not only education but also its initial processing should get digitized. Many prestigious institutions are listed on Admizz.com. Students can see the listed institutions in the city of their choice. One can also see the college description, courses oﬀered, fee structure, and also reviews of the selected institution.

After getting all these details, students can apply online to get admission to the Institute of their choice. One can save a lot of time, money, and eﬀort by using @Admizz.com. One can also mail us for any support and get assistance from our trained employees. Our vision is to make the admission procedures very simple for students with the use of technology. Admizz.com is managed by INRA EduTech Services Pvt. Ltd. and MKS Technology Pvt. Ltd. in India and Nepal respectively.

Source: ICTframe

title.rendered: Online application vs application through direct consultancy

content.rendered:
Exams have come to an end and most of the boards have already released the results. The biggest thing on every student’s mind right now is the next step. Every step of education is very important and it is best practice to prefer a better college, be it for high school, pre-graduation, graduation, or post-graduation. Better institutions might not always be near our premises and distance being a matter of delayed communication, many students and their parents prefer to go through the admission process via a consultancy. Especially for applying to colleges beyond the borders of a nation, consultancies are approached. But is this the only way available for admissions between 2 countries? NO!

 Over the past few years, the internet has exploded and grown at a great pace. Applying through colleges across country borders has also become easier with this. While some colleges directly take in applications through their websites, there are websites like www.admizzeducation.com that offer students the privilege to apply to as many colleges as possible. Such websites also facilitate the search for colleges and provide information regarding the colleges. In spite of this growth in the internet, consultancy application is still preferred by many students and parents. Here is a list of reasons why it is a better step to apply online, rather than through a consultancy

1. Cost factor:

Consultancies charge a high amount of fee other than the application fee, which is definitely an extra burden; at least for most students. Applying online doesn’t cost extra for students and is totally free.

2. Transparency:

 Although some consultancies maintain transparency in terms of college fees and other details, most consultancies never show the correct fee details. This never happens during the online application.

3. Fake consultancies: 

 Due to the blind faith that people put in consultancies, there has been a high increase in the number of fake consultancies and the number of people getting cheated in the name of consultancy. So it is suggested to apply either directly online via the college website or via authenticated application providers like Admizz.com

4. Consultancy – college partnership: 

 Many consultancies, especially the ones for overseas education, have collaborations with a few colleges, which are mostly prompted by the consultancies. In the case of online applications, promoted colleges and ads are clearly mentioned so, so that the students are given a choice to choose from all colleges.

5. Reviews:

 While applying online, reviews are also shown which helps the students in understanding the college better. This is not possible in the case of Consultancies since only the word of consultancy has to be taken into consideration.

6. Smarter and easier:

 When applications are filled online, every update and response is directed to our inboxes which can be viewed in our comfort. In the case of consultancy applications, timely visits around consultancies become mandatory, consuming time and energy a lot!

 Not just these, while applying to online websites like Admizz.com, it is easier to directly address our queries to the colleges. Consultancies seldom help in student-college communication.

So be it engineering or nursing or MBA or any other college, Bangalore provides the best facilities for a better student life and future. Apply directly online with Admizz now!

title.rendered: Physical Vs Digital Vs Audio books: Which is better?

content.rendered:
If you are a reader, then it is sure that books have always been your friend. No matter whether you are a student or just a passionate reader, you have always found a way to read a book. People used to carry a book in their backpacks. They would hold it in their hand and read it. However, things have changed now. With the development of various technologies, you can carry millions of books in the palm of your hand with the help of devices like kindle. Not only this, in case you don’t want to read, you can simply listen to audiobooks as well. E-books and audiobooks have changed the reading habit of people. This article is all about physical digital and audiobooks However, these regular, digital, and audiobooks have their pros and cons.

Pros and Cons of Digital Books

Digital books have brought new reading habits. You can store hundreds of books on your phone or E-readers like kindle. Just carry it and you can read it anywhere whether it’s day or night. Here is the list of pros and cons of digital or E-books.

Pros:

  • You can fit hundreds or even thousands of e-books on your device and read them anywhere.
  • You can change the font size as well as style according to your choice. As it comes with various features, even a visually impaired person can read it without any trouble.
  • Digital books come with a built-in dictionary which can help you to know the meaning of complex words.
  • With a mess-free library in your hand, digital books offer the feature to view all your highlights at a glance.

Cons:

  • While reading an Ebook, you may get distracted when your phone buzzes off with notifications.
  • Though the battery lasts for a longer period, you still have to charge your phone or Kindle.
  • You cannot get a physical copy of your favorite book when it comes to digital books.

Pros and Cons of Regular Books

Holding their favorite book while taking a sip of coffee is still a favorite pastime for most people. The smell of the new book brings a different kind of happiness to readers. No matter how various kinds of technologies get developed, people still prefer regular books over others. Let’s discuss the pros and cons of regular books.

Pros:

  •     You can read your book in peace without worrying about if your phone or e-reader’s battery is dead.
  •     You can easily lend and borrow any physical book with your friends and loved ones.
  •     While your phone may buzz off anytime with notifications, your regular book will never distract you with notifications.
  •     Sometimes you highlight or mark your favorite quote in the book. Years later, you can look back at the book and enjoy reading the notes again.

Cons:

  •     While reading a book, you will need a good source of light. You can’t read a book in the dark.
  •     If we look in the long term, buying books is more expensive than owning E-readers.
  •     Regular books are not portable compared to E-readers.
  •     Physical books allow you to keep a library and display everything you’ve read or plan to read. They can be used as décor too. 

Pros and Cons of Audio Books

Audiobooks are revolutionary as even when you are too tired to turn the pages of your book or when you don’t spend too much time on screen, it allows you to listen to your favorite book. These books have made the information found in books accessible to everyone. Physical digital and audiobooks, it has more advantages. However, these also have their advantages and disadvantages which are mentioned below:

Pros:

  •     No matter what you are doing, you can always listen to an audiobook. You don’t need to schedule a separate time for reading.
  •     You can be anywhere: flying in a plane or working in a kitchen and still listening to audiobooks.
  •     Even if you are out in the dark, you can listen to audiobooks.
  •     You can multitask while listening to audiobooks.
  •     If you have a smaller place, you don’t have to worry about where to keep your books.

Cons:

  •     You cannot highlight or mark your favorite part as in physical or digital books.
  •     Audiobooks take up a relatively large amount of space on your device.
  •     They are comparatively more expensive than both eBook and their physical edition.
  •     You need access to power to consume audiobooks which means your device should be well-charged.

If you are wondering which is best among these three, you don’t have to. All three types of books i.e physical digital and audiobooks come in handy to people according to their needs. For example, a visually impaired person relies on audiobooks whereas a bookaholic can prefer physical books. Thus, find the one that is most suitable for you and start reading.

content.rendered:
Education is a continuous process. This journey started when man was homeless and speechless and has now reached a state where man is searching for a home on Mars too. Since then education has never been the same. From what is learned to the way is learned, everything has changed, and is still changing. Here is how the journey went on:

Nomadic Education: It was a time when nobody knew anything and man was his own teacher. He on his own learned how to hunt and travel. But he was no different from animals. Communication was just improving. His education was still unrefined! But he took the first step of transformation from an animal to a social animal.

Arts & Teacher: After hunting, he started learning art. carving monuments out of stones, drawing, making coins, and writing! He started spreading the word to the next generations. He was a teacher now to his own people. Every family taught their off-springs about danger, about arts, etc., Human beings started getting better and more civilized. By now he was a settled citizen.

Gurukuls: Local gurus used to teach every student of that area everything they needed to know while growing up. Arts, culture, language everything was a part of it. There were no divisions or branches in this education. Nevertheless, the concept of schools is stated here. People were taught everything and were made jack of all trades. Students who entered gurukuls at an early age used to leave it as complete person by their 20th year.

Divided Educational Institutions: Education started being divided. The ideology that a student can learn something better if the teaching is more specific, started to raise. Yes, this way more efficient and effective professionals were made. Students got the opportunity to learn deeper things they love. Education became more professional and civilized. By this stage, education was an important aspect of society. Engineering colleges, arts colleges, science colleges, home science colleges everything came up and education got a strict curriculum and ya, even a ministry!

Online Courses: Students started becoming teachers themselves and the internet started teaching. What started as parallel online courses slowly became mainstream education too! Other than mainstream online courses, Currently, online courses are the second highest caterers of education. But of course, online courses aren’t as effective as actual institutions.

Next: The ongoing period is of semi-digital education. More effective classroom education combined with more efficient digital processes. Digital teaching in the classrooms, digitized processes, e-books, online notices everything are a part of this. This has started showing better results with it being a more effective form of it. Our own www.admizz.com as a digital way to apply and get admission directly through the digital world is one example of this on-growing semi-digital education.

Clearly, new steps of education have been arising and these new steps have always been cumulative. It would be interesting to see where these shifting winds of education finally reach! Wherever they reach man’s pursuit of education will never definitely end!

title.rendered: Tips for overall development of your child

content.rendered:
Almost half of the session is over and your child has been labeled as an underperformer in the class. It is obvious that parents worry about the academic growth of their children. Often parents get the blame for the poor performance of their child in academics.

Here are a few tips to guide your child in improving his / her grades in school

Improve Confidence: An examination grade should not be able to shatter the confidence of your little one. You must know how to convince your child about his/her caliber and boost his / her confidence.

Follow a Routine: Try to make a daily routine for the kid and make sure he/she follows it without fail. The routine must be a balanced one including recreational activities, and outdoor sports, and focus on every subject in the syllabus.

Follow the Social Circle: You may look at your child as a toddler but the fact is that he has started going out in the world and making his own peer group with other little ones. To know a man, know his company. Try to know the kind of company he likes to have, and if it is not proper, try to change it. But always remember to be rational with the child rather than being forceful.

Know the strengths and weaknesses: Know the favorite subject of the kid where he can actually excel once he grows up. Try to motivate him more in that area. At the same time, know his weak subjects and help him do well there. You can take the help of online tutors or other materials available.

Personality Development: The duty of parents is not only to give good education but also to instill the virtues like patience, perseverance, honesty, hard work, and determination in the child. You need to be a little detached from your child at times to keep the track of his / her personal and academic development. The personal development of the child is a very important part of his / her academics. If the kid has no patience or no inclination to work hard, he cannot excel in life when he/she gets on his own.

Source: CareerIndia

Here are a few things about the Atal Tinkering Labs(ATL) for you to recall.

1. By adding 1,500 schools to the program, the AIM, since it started operations over a year back, has 2,441 schools to cover.

2. ATLs are advanced play workspaces for understudies between Class 6 to 12, fortifying developments and consolidating science and innovation.

3. These open-finished advancement workspaces are furnished with best-in-class innovations like 3D printers, mechanical autonomy, sensor innovation units, Internet of Things, scaled-down gadgets, and so on, to empower understudies to learn and take care of neighborhood group issues utilizing developing advances.

4. The point of Atal Labs is to advance development and enterprise in schools, colleges, and industry with a dream to “develop one million kids in India as the pioneers of tomorrow”, an announcement from NITI Aayog has said.

5. The 2,441 schools have been chosen from more than 25,000 or more applications to date from two rounds of utilizations.

6. With the expansion of the new schools, the scope of ATLs will be reached out to more than 98% of shrewd urban areas, and 93% or more of the locale (655 or more regions). Its spread is apparent from the way that there will now be no less than at least one ATLs in 34 states and union regions the nation over.

7. Understudies officially presented to inventive innovation stages to sustain their interest, innovativeness, and creative ability through ATLs in their schools, have begun planning model arrangements and propelled imaginative tasks, for example, better water system administration, squander administration, and sensor-based arrangements utilizing IOT gadgets and mechanical technology in their labs, an announcement from NITI Aayog said.

8. ATL mission chief R. Ramanan has said the dynamic engagement of ATLs is critical in “the mission to change India into an imaginative nation”.

title.rendered: What makes Bangalore a favored destination for student?

content.rendered:
A recent survey found that most number of students from across the country and abroad choose to pursue higher education in Karnataka over any other state.

Karnataka is the top higher-study destination in the country, with around 1.8 lakh students coming to the state from across India to pursue higher education. While Manipal is undeniably the education hub of the state — as it attracts students the world over — Bangalore is also a preferred destination.

Weather and Safety Seal the Deal

Safety plays a big role in students choosing to travel across the country. Parents of senior software engineer Sarah Maryam, who hails from Aligarh in Uttar Pradesh, were more comfortable with their daughter coming to Bangalore, instead of a city closer to home. “My parents wanted me to go to a city where they wouldn’t have to worry about my safety. It helped that my brother was already living in Bangalore,” she says.

Parents also had a role to play in PR professional Tania Das’s decision to come to Bangalore from Assam. “Several of my father’s friends’ children studied in Bangalore, which is why he wanted me to come here. Also, Bangalore colleges are easier to get into when compared to, say, Delhi. Moreover, the people here are more accepting of others and the good weather was an added bonus,” says Tania.

Coursing Through

Shubli Saleem, from Jammu and Kashmir, wanted to study computer science, and Bangalore’s IT city tag was a big draw. “Bangalore is India’s IT city, and since I wanted to do computer science, I felt that the opportunities would be better here,” says the software engineer, who also lists safety and the good weather as benefits.

For Shijo Kurian, from Kerala, it was the promise of a better future that drew him to Bangalore. “There are a lot of options for people here. The infrastructure is good and there are several facilities for residents. When it came to higher education, Bangalore was my only choice,” says Shijo.

Gauravi Keni, from Goa, a Master in English student at a city college, considered applying in several cities but picked Bangalore as she felt that the semester timing and the course itself suited her best. Several of my seniors have passed out from this college and had given me positive feedback. I wanted to apply to a college in Pune, but that didn’t work out, so Bangalore was my next best option,” she says.

Family Comforts

When it was time for social media executive Arla Lyngdoh, from Shillong, to start looking for colleges, Bangalore was the obvious choice. “I have a lot of families here; my sister, cousins, nephews, and nieces all live in Bangalore. They had all told me good things about the city, so when it was time to pursue higher education, it was the logical choice,” she says. Ask her why she didn’t consider studying in Delhi, given that it’s closer to home, and Arla says, “I never got any positive feedback about the city. Plus, it gets very hot there. The weather in Bangalore is very similar to that of my hometown.”

Source: Times of India

title.rendered: Why Study In India Instead Of US/Australia?

content.rendered:
A large chunk of Nepalese students goes abroad to pursue their higher education. With the demand for abroad education increasing excessively, the supply for the same is also evident. Universities have started offering different kinds of student services like scholarships, job placements, and counseling, among others to allure international students into their institutions. If you make an observant generalization, it can be seen that most Nepalese students planning to go abroad prefer western countries like the United States of America, Canada, or Australia. However, the population of Nepalese students approaching to study in India is also on the rise. This is obviously not a coincidence that in a country where studying in a western country is a fashionable trend, people have started considering India as a strong contender as their prospective study destination as well. It is interesting to ponder upon why students prefer going to our neighboring country instead of a much more developed and facilitated West.

1. Cultural Resemblance

First and foremost, India is the one country whose culture is the most similar to that of Nepal. To add to that, a majority of Nepalese have also grown up friendly with the Bollywood movies and the language. We are all social beings who are a part of a specific culture. No matter where we go, we will always look for a place similar to our own culture. What better place than India, whose culture is so similar to our own? One of the reasons India might be appealing to Nepalese students for their higher education is the similarity in culture.

2. The Affordability Factor

Secondly, most of Nepalese who want to study abroad have a huge villain to defeat – money. For a middle-class Nepali family, the affordability factor is vital before making the decision to whether or not to send their children to study abroad. India is the perfect solution to this problem. Studying in India is relatively cheaper for a Nepali student than in any other western country.

3. Convenience in Travelling

Another factor that goes hand in hand with the affordability factor is the convenience of traveling. There is no visa requirement to travel to India, and you can travel by airplane or train, or even a bus (in some places). So, traveling back and forth is extremely convenient. Even the parents feel better sending their sons or daughters off to India to study because it is closer and they won’t be absolutely gone for many years during their study period. The students will be easily able to visit during important occasions such as festivals or other family emergencies, which is less likely if they study in Western countries.

4. Quality of Education

Along with all these factors, the fact that the quality of education in India is great is one of the major reasons behind the preference of Nepalese students to study in India. India is one of the most competitive countries when it comes to quality education. To add to that, admission is any Indian educational institution is relatively easier.

When you consider all these factors, it is quite evident why students are showing preference towards India for higher studies. For students from Nepal, India is a convenient destination to study, where they can be independent but also be close to home.

content.rendered:
Higher education in India has been a topic of much debate and discussion in recent years. With a population of over 1.3 billion, India is home to one of the largest and most diverse student populations in the world.

In recent years, there has been a significant push to expand access to higher education in India. The government has set a target to raise the gross enrollment ratio (GER) in higher education to 30% by 2020. This goal has been achieved, with a GER of 31.3% in 2019-20.

To achieve this goal, the government has implemented a number of initiatives and policies. One major initiative is the establishment of new universities and colleges, particularly in rural and underserved areas. The government has also increased higher education funding, focusing on scholarships and fellowships for disadvantaged students.

In addition to government initiatives, the private sector has also played a major role in expanding access to higher education in India. Private universities and colleges have been established in large numbers, and many of these institutions have become major players in the higher education landscape.

However, despite these efforts, there are still significant challenges facing higher education in India. Quality remains a major concern, with many institutions facing inadequate infrastructure and a lack of qualified faculty. Additionally, there is still a significant gap in access to higher education between urban and rural areas, as well as between different socioeconomic groups.

In recent years, there has been a push towards online and distance education as a means of expanding access to higher education. The government has been promoting the idea of “education on demand” and in 2020, the University Grants Commission (UGC) allowed online education to be a regular mode of teaching.

In conclusion, while there has been significant progress in expanding access to higher education in India, there are still substantial challenges that need to be addressed. The government and private sector will need to continue to work together to improve the quality of higher education and to ensure that all students, regardless of their background, have the opportunity to access and succeed in higher education.

title.rendered: Which is better computer engineering or computer science engineering?

content.rendered:
Admizz Education offers students the opportunity to study Computer Science Engineering (CSE) and Computer Engineering (CE) in India, as well as the option to study abroad. Understanding the differences between CSE and CE is important for students when choosing a career path or selecting a course of study.

CSE focuses primarily on software development, including programming languages, algorithms, data structures, and software design, while CE deals with both software and hardware, including computer systems, digital circuits, and embedded systems.

CSE students study a wide range of topics in software engineering, including programming languages, databases, and software development methodologies, while CE students study computer architecture, digital design, and computer networks, in addition to software engineering topics.

Graduates of CSE typically pursue careers in software development, data science, and web development, while CE graduates may work in hardware design, system integration, or software development in areas such as embedded systems or device drivers.

CSE students develop a strong foundation in software development, including programming and software design, while CE students have a more comprehensive skill set that includes knowledge of hardware and software systems, as well as a deep understanding of computer architecture and digital design.

At Admizz Education, students have the option to study either CSE or CE in India or study abroad. Our team of experienced professionals will guide students through the process of selecting the best program and institution to meet their academic and career goals.

title.rendered: Top 3 Reasons to Study in India

content.rendered:
Affordability

Studying in India is much more affordable than studying in any other western country. You can get a high-quality education at a cost that you can afford. The cost of tuition fees and living expenses in India is significantly lower than in the United States, the United Kingdom, or Canada. Additionally, there are various scholarships and grants available for international students to help them finance their studies.

Taught in English

One of the biggest advantages of studying in India is that the majority of the courses are taught in English. This means that you won’t have to go through the hassle of learning a new language before you can start your studies. Studying in English also opens up a range of opportunities for you, including the ability to communicate with local people and businesses.

Diverse Course Options

Indian universities offer diverse course options that you can choose from. Whether you want to study engineering, medicine, business, or social sciences, there are plenty of options available. Based on your interests and career aspirations, you can choose the best available course for yourself. This diversity of options ensures that students are equipped with the knowledge and skills they need to succeed in their chosen career paths.

If you are considering studying in India, please send us a direct message to learn more about how we can assist you with the application process, finding a suitable university, and settling in.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title.rendered: Top 5 Reasons to study in the USA

content.rendered:
Want to go abroad to study but not sure where to go? Well, look no further. We are here with five compelling reasons why you should consider studying in the USA!

  • High-Quality Education: The United States is home to some of the most prestigious universities in the world, including Harvard, Yale, and Stanford. These institutions offer top-notch education and provide students with the skills and knowledge they need to succeed in their chosen field.
  • Diversity: With over 50 states and countless cities and towns, the United States offers a wide range of experiences and cultures. You’ll have the opportunity to meet people from all over the world and gain a broader understanding of different cultures and ways of life.
  • Career Opportunities: The US is home to some of the world’s largest and most innovative companies, providing students with a wealth of career opportunities. Many universities have close ties with these companies, offering students the chance to gain real-world experience and connections in their chosen field.
  • Flexibility: American universities offer a wide range of programs and courses, allowing you to tailor your education to your interests and career goals. You can choose from a variety of majors, minors, and electives, as well as take advantage of internships, research opportunities, and study abroad programs.
  • Life Experience: Studying in the United States is not just about the education; it’s also about the experience. You’ll have the chance to explore new places, meet new people, and immerse yourself in a new culture. This can be a life-changing experience that will help you grow personally and professionally.

Overall, studying in the United States offers a wealth of benefits, from high-quality education and career opportunities to a diverse and enriching cultural experience. Consider the US for your study abroad plans and you won’t be disappointed!

Contact Admizz Education today to learn more about studying in the USA.

title.rendered: Top 5 Best Universities in the U.S.A

content.rendered:
The United States of America is home to some of the world’s top-ranked universities, offering a diverse range of academic programs and research opportunities. In this article, we will explore the top 5 universities in the USA that have earned global recognition for their academic excellence and research achievements.

Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT):

Located in Cambridge, Massachusetts, MIT is a world-renowned institution for its research and education in science, engineering, and technology. Founded in 1861, it has a student body of over 11,500 students and faculty of over 1,000. MIT offers undergraduate, graduate, and professional degree programs in various fields, including engineering, science, management, and social sciences. MIT’s alumni include 96 Nobel laureates, 25 Turing Award winners, and 8 Fields Medalists.

Stanford University:

Located in the heart of Silicon Valley in California, Stanford University is known for its pioneering research in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM) fields. It was founded in 1885 and has since grown to become one of the top universities in the USA. Stanford has a diverse student body of over 17,000 students and faculty of over 2,200. It offers undergraduate, graduate, and professional degree programs in various fields, including computer science, engineering, business, and law. Stanford’s alumni include 30 Nobel laureates, 18 Turing Award winners, and 11 Pulitzer Prize winners.

Harvard University

Located in Cambridge, Massachusetts, Harvard University is one of the most prestigious universities in the world. Founded in 1636, it is the oldest institution of higher learning in the USA. Harvard has a diverse student body and faculty, including over 20,000 students and 2,400 faculty members. Harvard offers undergraduate, graduate, and professional degree programs in various fields, including law, business, medicine, and education. Harvard’s alumni include eight U.S. presidents, 158 Nobel laureates, and 14 Turing Award winners.

California Institute of Technology (Caltech):

Located in Pasadena, California, Caltech is a private research university known for its strength in science and engineering. Founded in 1891, Caltech has a student body of over 2,200 students and faculty of over 300. It offers undergraduate, graduate, and professional degree programs in various fields, including physics, mathematics, engineering, and biology. Caltech’s alumni include 39 Nobel laureates, 6 Turing Award winners, and 1 Fields Medalist.

University of Chicago

The University of Chicago, located in Chicago, Illinois, is another top-ranked university in the USA. It was founded in 1890 and is known for its strong emphasis on research and intellectual inquiry. The university has a diverse student body and faculty of over 17,000 students and 3,300 faculty members. The University of Chicago offers undergraduate, graduate, and professional degree programs in various fields, including economics, law, business, social sciences, and humanities. The university has produced numerous Nobel laureates, including 91 Nobel Prize winners in total, making it one of the top universities in the world for producing Nobel Prize winners. 

These are the top 5 universities in the USA that have earned global recognition for their academic excellence and research achievements. Whether you are interested in STEM fields, social sciences, humanities, or other academic disciplines, these universities offer a diverse range of programs and resources to help you achieve your academic and professional goals.

title.rendered: 3 Reasons Why You Should Study at KIIT University

content.rendered:
Are you looking for a university that offers world-class education and excellent career opportunities? Look no further than KIIT University. Here are the top three reasons why you should consider studying at KIIT University:

Top Rankings

KIIT University is ranked No. 1 among the Private Higher Education Indian Universities by Atal Ranking of Institutions on Innovation Achievements (ARIIA), Ministry of Human Resource Development Government of India. This is a testament to the university’s commitment to innovation and excellence in education. The university is also highly ranked by the Times Higher Education ‘World University Ranking,’ with its Computer Science Engineering program ranking in the cohort of 301-400 and its overall Engineering ranking in the cohort of 401-500 in the world.

Global Recognition

KIIT University has gained recognition and respect from various international organizations for its excellence in teaching and research. In 2021, KIIT University became India’s first QS 5 Stars Rated University, receiving 5 stars after assessing all the categories of QS criteria. This recognition is proof of the university’s global standard and commitment to providing the best education to its students.

Wide Range of Courses

KIIT University offers a wide range of undergraduate and postgraduate courses in various disciplines such as engineering, law, medicine, management, fashion, film, and more. With highly experienced faculty and state-of-the-art infrastructure, KIIT University provides a comprehensive education to its students that prepares them for successful careers in their chosen fields.

If you’re looking for a university that offers top rankings, global recognition, and a wide range of courses, KIIT University is the right choice for you. Contact us today to learn more about how we can help you achieve your educational goals.

title.rendered: Five Reasons Why You Should Study in Australia

content.rendered:
Australia is a highly popular destination for international students, attracting students from all over the world. In this article, we’ll explore the top three reasons why you should consider studying in Australia.

Globally Ranked Institutions

Australia is home to some of the world’s leading educational institutions, which offer a first-rate education, great professors, and comprehensive student support services. According to independent global rankings such as Times Higher Education, QS, and Shanghai Rankings, Australian universities consistently rank highly on the global stage.

Gain Work Experience Along with Outstanding Education

Many Australian degrees and vocational courses include work experience programs and internships so you can gain hands-on industry experience and grow your professional network while you study. This is an excellent opportunity to apply the knowledge and skills you’ve gained in your course to real-world situations and gain valuable work experience.

Safe Environment

Australian cities have some of the lowest crime rates in the world, and our streets and public spaces are open and safe. Australia is a peaceful and welcoming country, and our multicultural society reflects this. This means that you can enjoy your time studying in Australia without worrying about your safety or wellbeing.

Quality of Life

Australia is consistently ranked as one of the best countries in the world to live in, thanks to its high quality of life, excellent healthcare system, and strong economy. Studying in Australia gives you access to this high standard of living, as well as a wealth of cultural and recreational opportunities.

English Language Skills

Studying in Australia provides an excellent opportunity to improve your English language skills. As English is the primary language of instruction, you will have ample opportunities to practice your language skills in a supportive and immersive environment. This can help you gain a competitive edge in the global job market and open up new opportunities for your career.

content.rendered:
Dubai is a city that offers world-class education opportunities for students. With a reputation for quality education and a thriving entrepreneurial culture, Dubai has become an attractive destination for students seeking to advance their careers. In this response, we will outline five benefits of studying in Dubai.

  1. Multicultural Environment: Dubai is a melting pot of cultures, and studying in such an environment offers students the opportunity to interact with people from all over the world. This experience helps them develop a global perspective, which is valuable for their future careers.
  1. Quality Education: Dubai is home to many universities that are globally recognized for providing high-quality education. The quality of education is supported by highly qualified faculty, state-of-the-art facilities, and modern teaching methodologies.
  1. Career Opportunities: Dubai is a hub for business and finance, making it a great place for students to launch their careers. The city is home to many multinational corporations, providing students with access to numerous job opportunities, internships, and industry connections.
  1. High Standard of Living: Dubai offers a high standard of living for students, with excellent infrastructure, modern amenities, and world-class healthcare facilities.
  1. Vibrant Social Scene: Dubai offers a vibrant social scene for students with its numerous restaurants, cafes, and entertainment venues. The city is also known for its shopping and nightlife, providing students with a well-rounded experience.

Studying in Dubai offers numerous benefits for students, including exposure to a multicultural environment, access to high-quality education, abundant career opportunities, a high standard of living, and a vibrant social scene. These benefits make Dubai an attractive destination for students seeking to advance their careers and experience a unique cultural environment.

title.rendered: Four Documents To Prepare For University Applications

content.rendered:
When applying for university, it is important to ensure that you have all the necessary documents ready to submit with your application. While the exact requirements may vary depending on the institution and program, there are four key documents that are commonly required.

1.Transcripts

Transcripts are an essential component of any university application. They provide a detailed record of your academic performance, including grades and courses taken. It is important to ensure that your transcripts are accurate and up-to-date.

2. Standardized Test Scores

 Standardized test scores are often required as part of the application process. These may include tests such as the SAT, ACT, or GRE, depending on the program and institution. These scores provide a standardized way of evaluating applicants and are used to determine eligibility and admission decisions.

3. English Language Proficiency Scores

If you are an international student or a non-native English speaker, you will likely need to provide English language proficiency scores. Common tests include the TOEFL or IELTS. These scores demonstrate your ability to communicate effectively in English and ensure that you are able to participate fully in the academic program.

4. Letters of Recommendation 

Letters of recommendation are often required to support your application. These may be written by teachers, professors, employers, or other professionals who can attest to your academic abilities and personal qualities. It is important to choose individuals who know you well and can provide meaningful insights into your character and potential.

In conclusion, preparing these four documents ahead of time will help ensure a smooth and successful university application process. It is important to check the specific requirements for each institution and program to ensure that you are providing all the necessary documents.

For easier processing, contact Admizz Education today!

title.rendered: 5 Reasons Why UK is an Ideal Study Destination

content.rendered:
The UK is a popular study destination for international students, and for good reason. With globally recognized academic excellence, promising career opportunities, shorter courses, the ability to work while you learn, and a rich cultural diversity, the UK offers students an unparalleled educational experience. In this article, we will explore five reasons why the UK is an ideal study destination for international students.

Internationally recognized academic excellence:

UK universities are globally recognized for their academic excellence and research output. They consistently rank among the top institutions in the world, with many of them being members of the prestigious Russell Group of universities. UK degrees are highly regarded by employers worldwide, making them a valuable asset for students seeking a successful career.

Promising employability and career opportunities:

UK universities have strong links with industry and offer students opportunities to gain practical experience through internships, work placements, and other industry-focused initiatives. Many universities also have dedicated career services that provide students with guidance and support to enhance their employability and secure rewarding careers after graduation.

Shorter duration of courses: 

Unlike other countries, most undergraduate courses in the UK are only three years long, and postgraduate courses are typically one year in duration. This not only reduces the overall cost of education but also allows students to enter the workforce or pursue further studies earlier than their counterparts in other countries.

Work while you learn: 

International students in the UK are allowed to work part-time during term-time and full-time during vacations. This provides them with the opportunity to earn some extra money to support their studies and gain valuable work experience that can enhance their employability after graduation.

Cultural diversity: 

The UK is a multicultural society with a diverse student population from all around the world. Students in the UK can experience a wide range of cultures, customs, and traditions, making it a unique and enriching learning experience. The country also has a rich history and heritage, with world-renowned museums, art galleries, and historical sites that offer students the opportunity to explore and learn outside of the classroom.

In conclusion, the UK is an excellent destination for international students seeking quality education, career prospects, and cultural diversity. If you’re considering studying in the UK, Admizz Education can help you through the application process. We offer expert guidance and support to ensure you have the best chance of being accepted into your desired university. Don’t miss out on this opportunity – apply to study in the UK with Admizz Education today!

content.rendered:
IELTS (International English Language Testing System) and PTE (Pearson Test of English) are two of the most widely recognized standardized tests for assessing English language proficiency, and both are accepted by thousands of universities, employers, and immigration authorities worldwide. Despite having similar goals, there are some key differences between the two tests.

Test Format:

The most noticeable difference between the two tests is their format. IELTS is a paper-based test, whereas PTE is a computer-based test. In the IELTS test, candidates fill in their answers on a paper answer sheet, while in the PTE test, candidates interact with a computer interface to answer the questions.

Test Content:

Both IELTS and PTE assess the four key language skills – reading, writing, speaking, and listening – but the format and content of the questions may differ. For instance, the speaking section of the PTE test involves recording your voice into a microphone, while the IELTS test requires a face-to-face interview with an examiner. Additionally, the PTE test includes a section on oral fluency, which requires the test-taker to speak in response to a prompt for a short period of time.

Test Scoring:

Both tests are scored on a scale from 0 to 9, but the scoring criteria and algorithms used to determine the final score may differ. IELTS is scored by a human examiner based on a standardized rubric, while PTE uses automated scoring technology to analyze responses.

Test Availability:

Another important factor to consider when choosing between IELTS and PTE is test availability. IELTS is available in over 140 countries, with more than 1,600 test centers worldwide, while PTE is available in fewer locations. However, PTE is gaining in popularity and is now offered in over 50 countries, and its computer-based format allows for greater flexibility and convenience.

In conclusion, the choice between IELTS and PTE ultimately depends on individual preferences and requirements, such as test availability and test format. It’s important to research and compare the tests before making a decision, and to consult with educational institutions or immigration authorities to determine which test is preferred or required for your specific situation. Admizz Education can also assist you with choosing the appropriate test and providing support throughout the application process.

title.rendered: Top 5 Universities of India Based on NIRF Rankings 2023

content.rendered:
National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF) is an initiative by the Government of India to rank higher education institutions across the country. The rankings are based on several parameters, including teaching, research, perception, and outreach. In this article, we will explore the top 5 universities based on the NIRF rankings of 2023.

Indian Institute of Science:

The Indian Institute of Science (IISc) in Bangalore is consistently ranked as the top university in India according to the NIRF rankings. Established in 1909, IISc is a premier institution for scientific research and higher education in various disciplines. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs in science, engineering, design, and management. The institute’s commitment to excellence in research, world-class faculty, and state-of-the-art infrastructure contribute to its top-ranking position.

Jawaharlal Nehru University:

Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU), located in New Delhi, is renowned for its academic and research contributions in social sciences, humanities, and languages. With a diverse and vibrant campus environment, JNU fosters interdisciplinary studies and intellectual debates. The university offers undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs across various disciplines. JNU’s emphasis on critical thinking, social inclusivity, and academic freedom has made it one of the top universities in India.

Jamia Millia Islamia:

Jamia Millia Islamia, located in New Delhi, is a central university known for its focus on education, research, and innovation. Established in 1920, it has evolved into a leading institution for higher education. Jamia Millia Islamia offers a wide range of programs in fields such as humanities, social sciences, engineering, law, and technology. The university’s commitment to social justice, cultural diversity, and academic excellence has earned it a prominent place in the NIRF rankings.

Jadavpur University:

Jadavpur University, situated in Kolkata, is renowned for its excellence in engineering, technology, arts, and sciences. Established in 1955, the university has consistently ranked among the top institutions in India. Jadavpur University offers undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs in various disciplines. Its strong emphasis on research, industry collaborations, and interdisciplinary studies has helped it maintain its position among the top universities in the country.

Banaras Hindu University:

Banaras Hindu University (BHU), located in Varanasi, is one of the oldest and largest residential universities in India. Founded in 1916, BHU has a rich history of academic excellence and has made significant contributions to various fields of knowledge. The university offers a wide range of undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs in disciplines such as arts, sciences, engineering, medicine, and agriculture. BHU’s focus on research, innovation, and holistic education has secured its position among the top universities in India.

For students aspiring to join these esteemed universities, seeking guidance and assistance can be crucial. Admizz Education is an organization that specializes in helping students with their admissions to top universities. By contacting Admizz Education, students can receive expert advice and support throughout the admission process, increasing their chances of securing a place in their desired university. 

If you’re a student looking to secure admission to one of these top universities, reach out to Admizz Education today and kickstart your journey towards a successful future today!

title.rendered: Top 5 Universities To Study in UK Based On QS Rankings 2023

content.rendered:
When it comes to pursuing higher education, the United Kingdom stands as a beacon of academic excellence. Renowned for their rich educational heritage, rigorous programs, and distinguished faculty, the UK universities attract students from around the world. In this article, we will explore some of the top universities in the UK, known for their global reputation and commitment to providing a transformative educational experience.

University of Oxford:

Topping the list is the University of Oxford, an institution that epitomizes academic excellence. Established in the 12th century, Oxford has consistently ranked among the world’s best universities. With its collegiate system, Oxford offers an intimate and intellectually stimulating environment. Students benefit from the tutelage of eminent scholars and access to extensive resources, fostering critical thinking and deep intellectual engagement.

University of Cambridge:

The University of Cambridge, founded in the 13th century, is another prestigious institution renowned for its world-class education. Cambridge’s scholarly legacy spans centuries, producing groundbreaking discoveries and nurturing some of the greatest minds in history. With its renowned faculties and state-of-the-art facilities, Cambridge offers a vibrant academic community that fosters creativity, research, and innovation.

Imperial College London:

Recognized for its emphasis on science, technology, engineering, and medicine, Imperial College London ranks high on the list of top UK universities. Renowned for its cutting-edge research and practical approach, Imperial equips students with the knowledge and skills needed to address complex global challenges. With a diverse student body and close ties to industry, Imperial offers excellent prospects for career advancement.

University College London (UCL):

UCL, one of London’s premier institutions, is renowned for its multidisciplinary approach and pioneering research. With a strong focus on innovation and collaboration, UCL attracts students who seek to explore the frontiers of knowledge. Its world-class faculty, combined with a vibrant cultural scene, provides students with a holistic educational experience.

The University of Edinburgh:

Nestled amidst the historical beauty of Scotland’s capital, the University of Edinburgh is a venerable institution with a rich heritage. Offering a wide range of programs, Edinburgh excels in fields such as humanities, social sciences, and sciences. The university’s commitment to research, coupled with its strong links to industry and cultural opportunities, make it an ideal destination for students seeking a well-rounded education.

The UK’s top universities, including Oxford, Cambridge, Imperial College London, UCL, and the University of Edinburgh, represent a culmination of centuries of academic excellence. These institutions offer not only outstanding educational programs but also a stimulating intellectual environment that nurtures the growth of future leaders, innovators, and thinkers. While this article showcases some of the most prestigious universities in the UK, it’s important to note that each institution has its own unique strengths. Students should carefully consider their academic interests, career aspirations, and personal preferences to select the university that aligns best with their goals. Embarking on a journey of higher education at one of these esteemed universities promises a transformative experience that will shape the trajectory of one’s future endeavors.If you’re unsure about which university to choose, make sure you book your consultation call with Admizz today!

title.rendered: Top Courses To Study at KIIT University

content.rendered:
KIIT University, located in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, is renowned for its diverse range of academic programs and holistic approach to education. With a strong emphasis on innovation, research, and industry collaboration, KIIT offers a plethora of courses that cater to the varied interests and career aspirations of students. In this article, we will delve into some of the top courses offered at KIIT University, showcasing the university’s commitment to academic excellence and preparing students for a dynamic future.

Bachelors in Technology:

At KIIT, the Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) program stands out as a flagship course. The university offers a wide range of engineering disciplines, including Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, and many more. The B.Tech program at KIIT provides students with a comprehensive understanding of theoretical foundations and practical skills necessary to excel in the industry. With state-of-the-art laboratories, experienced faculty, and industry collaborations, KIIT equips students with a strong foundation for a successful engineering career.

Bachelors in Science Nursing:

The Bachelor of Science in Nursing (B.Sc Nursing) program at KIIT University is designed for students passionate about healthcare and patient care. KIIT’s nursing program focuses on developing clinical proficiency, critical thinking, and compassionate care. Through a combination of theoretical knowledge, practical training, and clinical experiences, students gain a deep understanding of healthcare practices, ethical considerations, and the latest advancements in the field. The program prepares students for diverse roles in hospitals, clinics, research institutions, and community health organizations.

Bachelors in Business Administration:

For those aspiring to become business leaders and entrepreneurs, the Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) program at KIIT offers a comprehensive curriculum. With a focus on building managerial skills, strategic thinking, and an understanding of global business practices, the BBA program equips students with a strong foundation in areas such as finance, marketing, human resources, and operations. The program also emphasizes experiential learning through internships, industry projects, and interactive sessions with industry experts, preparing students for a wide range of managerial roles.

Bachelors in Film and Television Production:

KIIT University recognizes the growing influence of media and entertainment industries and offers a Bachelor’s program in Film and Television Production. This program provides students with a creative platform to explore various aspects of filmmaking, including direction, cinematography, editing, and screenwriting. With access to state-of-the-art production facilities and guidance from experienced industry professionals, students gain practical skills and industry insights necessary to thrive in the competitive world of film and television.

Bachelor of Architecture:

KIIT University’s Bachelor of Architecture program aims to nurture creative and talented individuals aspiring to shape the built environment. The program emphasizes a holistic approach to architecture, incorporating design thinking, sustainability, and technical expertise. Students engage in studio-based learning, collaborative projects, and field visits, allowing them to develop their design skills and gain practical experience. KIIT’s architecture program prepares students for a rewarding career in architectural design, urban planning, and sustainable development.

KIIT University offers an impressive array of courses that cater to diverse academic interests and career aspirations. Whether one seeks to pursue engineering, healthcare, business administration, film and television production, or architecture, KIIT provides a conducive environment for holistic learning and personal growth. With its focus on industry relevance, practical exposure, and nurturing talent, KIIT equips students with the knowledge, skills, and confidence necessary to excel in their chosen fields. Embarking on an educational journey at KIIT University promises a transformative experience that sets the stage for a successful and fulfilling professional career.

title.rendered: Diwali: Illuminating Education and Celebrating Achievements

content.rendered:
Diwali, or Deepavali, transcends cultural boundaries, resonating with the spirit of Admizz Education. As the Festival of Lights, it symbolizes the triumph of knowledge and wisdom, values deeply cherished by students, achievers, and academic institutions alike. Let’s explore the rich traditions of Diwali, weaving in the essence of education and the aspirations of those aspiring to study abroad.

Historical Significance:

Diwali’s roots intertwine with ancient Hindu mythology, narrating tales of triumph over darkness. Lord Rama’s return, celebrated with the lighting of diyas, mirrors the academic journey – overcoming challenges for the brighter path ahead.

Traditions and Customs:

  • Cleansing Minds and Spaces:

Much like the meticulous preparation for exams, Diwali begins with cleaning homes, symbolizing the removal of negativity. Spaces are adorned with rangoli, reflecting the creativity and diversity that education brings.

  • Illuminating Minds:

Lighting diyas signifies dispelling ignorance, reflecting the pursuit of knowledge. It parallels the journey of students seeking enlightenment in academic institutions.

  • Puja and Wisdom:

Diwali prayers resonate with the spirit of seeking blessings, mirroring the academic pursuit of excellence. Goddess Lakshmi’s blessings echo the quest for prosperity and success in education.

In the modern context, Diwali celebrations extend beyond traditional customs. Cities, much like educational institutions, are adorned with lights, creating a vibrant atmosphere. Events, concerts, and displays symbolize the diverse achievements and talents of students and achievers.

Admizz Education embraces the Diwali spirit by illuminating the paths of aspiring achievers. Through partnerships with academies and institutions, Admizz fosters a community where students connect with associates to achieve academic success. As we celebrate Diwali, let us reflect on the achievements of students and the collaborative efforts of Admizz Education and its esteemed partners.

Diwali serves as a powerful metaphor for the journey of education, with light dispelling darkness and wisdom triumphing over ignorance. As we exchange sweets and good wishes, let us extend the celebration to encompass the shared achievements and aspirations of the Admizz Education community. May this Diwali illuminate the path to success and knowledge for students, achievers, and institutions alike.

title.rendered: Navigating Global Education: Celebrating International Students Day

content.rendered:
Every year on November 17th, International Students Day is celebrated globally to honor the remarkable contributions of students studying abroad. At Admizz Education, we take immense pride in being part of the journey that transforms dreams into reality. As we commemorate International Students Day, let’s delve into the world of education, the diverse programs we offer, and the incredible opportunities that await students in India, USA, Australia, France, Canada, and the UK.

Admizz Education: A Gateway to Global Learning

Admizz Education stands as a beacon of guidance for students aspiring to pursue education abroad. Our mission is to simplify the complex process of studying overseas, offering comprehensive support and personalized solutions for every student’s unique academic journey.

Abroad Study Programs Tailored to Excellence:

One of the key reasons Admizz Education is a preferred choice for international students is the wide array of programs we offer. From undergraduate to postgraduate studies, our portfolio encompasses diverse fields such as technology, business, healthcare, arts, and more. Our expert counselors work closely with students to understand their aspirations, guiding them towards programs that align with their career goals.

Exploring Educational Landscapes: India, USA, Australia, France, Canada, UK

  1. India: A cultural hub with a rich history, India has emerged as a popular destination for international students. Admizz Education facilitates seamless admission processes to renowned Indian institutions, opening doors to a world-class education.
  2. USA: The land of opportunities, the USA attracts students with its world-class universities and diverse programs. Admizz Education simplifies the application process, providing support at every step for those aiming to study in the United States.
  3. Australia: Known for its quality education and vibrant lifestyle, Australia is a top choice for many international students. Admizz Education assists in navigating the Australian education system, making the journey smoother for aspiring scholars.
  4. Canada: With its welcoming atmosphere and top-ranked institutions, Canada has become a preferred destination for students worldwide. Admizz Education facilitates the admission process, helping students build a foundation for a successful career.
  5. UK: Steeped in academic excellence, the UK boasts a rich educational heritage. Admizz Education guides students through the intricacies of studying in the UK, ensuring a seamless transition into the British education system.

Conclusion:

As we celebrate International Students Day, Admizz Education reaffirms its commitment to empowering students on their global academic journeys. Whether you’re dreaming of studying in India, France, USA, Australia, Canada, or the UK, Admizz Education is your trusted partner for turning aspirations into achievements. Join us in embracing the spirit of learning and discovery as we pave the way for a brighter future on this International Students Day.
